title: Symmetric basis
author: JG
description: add a function to compute a basis for two given non-parallel vectors; the average of the two vectors is computed from averaging normalized vectors (=mid axis) and according projections; used for NodeSlope12
releaseNotes: the frame of two slopes is their symmetric basis (RigidBodyMath::SymmetricBasis, exudyn.cUtilities and rigidBodyUtilities.SymmetricBasis), with a closed-form rotation Jacobian and its derivative by AutoDiff: NodePointSlope12, NodePointSlope23, ObjectANCFBeam, and ObjectANCFThinPlate, which gets a rotation for MarkerBodyRigid
